definitions.gloss: reply address; graduate's address (at a ceremony)
definitions.explanation: A formal speech given in reply to words of farewell or welcome, above all the address read by a representative of the graduating students at a Japanese graduation ceremony in answer to the {送辞|そうじ} of the younger students.

examples.japanese: {答辞|とうじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んだ→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
{卒業生代表|そつぎょうせいだいひょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{答辞|とうじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{述|の}べた→述べる：02389_noberu⟧。
examples.english: A representative of the graduates gave the reply address.

examples.japanese: {答辞|とうじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{詰|つ}まり→詰まる：02079_tsumaru⟧、⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦あちこち→あちこち：01687_achikochi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧すする⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえた→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧。
examples.english: Her voice caught in the middle of the reply address, and you could hear sniffling all around the hall.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
At a Japanese school graduation ceremony (⟦{卒業式|そつぎょうしき}→卒業式：05584_sotsugyoushiki⟧), a student from the year below reads the {送辞|そうじ} (farewell address), and a representative of the graduates answers with the {答辞|とうじ}, thanking teachers and parents and looking back on school life. Being chosen to read it is an honor.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {答辞|とうじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧: to read the reply address
- {答辞|とうじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{述|の}べる→述べる：02389_noberu⟧: to deliver the reply address
- {卒業生代表|そつぎょうせいだいひょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{答辞|とうじ}: the graduates' representative's address

RELATED WORDS:
- {送辞|そうじ}: farewell address to the graduates
- {式辞|しきじ}: address given by the principal or host
